raw:
@s1 stated
  relation "move"
  role subject "the user's father"
  role source "the hospital in Barlad"
  role destination "Iași"
  role instrument "a private ambulance"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s2 stated
  relation "charge"
  role subject "they"
  role object "the user"
  role topic "900 lei"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s3 stated
  relation "say"
  role subject "the doctor"
  role object "the transfer is free"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted
  speaker "the doctor"
  valid on "at Barlad"

@a1 assumed
  relation "be available"
  role subject "the ambulance from the county"
  polarity negated
  valid on "for three hours"
  basis implicature

@a2 assumed
  relation "inform"
  role subject "nobody"
  role object "the user"
  role topic "the need to pay"
  polarity negated
  basis implicature

@q query
  where match
    relation "must pay"
    role subject ?who
    role object "900 lei"
    polarity affirmed
  end
